_note: Optional local fallback. GEMINI_API_KEY / OPENROUTER_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the environment take precedence. Fill in only the providers your model chain uses — a model whose key is missing is skipped, not fatal. An OpenRouter key alone covers GPT and Claude, via vendor/model ids like anthropic/claude-sonnet-4. Copy to config.json; that path is gitignored, so never commit a real key.
